correctness.rationale: For every finite N and nonempty rule groups, logistic H updates render the chain irreducible even with zero mutation. The neutral first two spin moments close exactly and yield c and b; differentiating rates gives F_E=-kappa Q/4 and summing stationary drifts yields the claimed sharp multiplier and O(beta^2) expansion. Denominator positivity and Q>0 prove the strict boundary. The zero-mutation equal-contribution result follows by symbolic simplification. The exact eight-state rational coefficient (56r-323)/1260, 90 independent small Markov-chain finite derivatives and 19 rational identities were checked from the embedded program; finite enumeration does not substitute for the analytic all-size proof.

value.rationale: The mixed learning-rule ceiling is a natural gap explicitly raised by the June 2026 source. The result gives an exact arbitrary-finite-population response involving nontrivial neutral covariances, an aggregate-contribution sufficiency result and the mathematically sharp quadratic N^3/(2N-1) one-introspector hurdle. These clarify how a fixed intrinsic minority differs from pure introspection, rather than merely recomputing a known numerical table or adding a routine parameter.
